title: A great Time Had by All
text: Christopher our Captain was fantastic. He was attentive to all onboard. He was knowledgeable and I would certainly recommend this trip especially if Christopher was the Captain.
author: Sadnigel

title: Great time!
text: David was an excellent skipper and guide. He was so friendly,  knowledgeable and overall hospitable. We enjoyed our time with him and on the sailing cruise.
author: Kristina_T

title: Best sunset cruise ever
text:
The Captain and deck hand were superb. 
One of the best sunset cruises we’ve taken. 
Great job guys!!!
author: Evelyn_B

title: Beautiful Way to Experience the Mediterranean
text: This was a great end of day activity to rest our sore tourist legs. The check in was easy. Our skipper was friendly and even let my wife help sail/navigate for a bit. The tapas (selection of 4 items) were tasty and the drink options sufficient (wine, beer, water, soft drinks). While we had hoped to jump in the water it was a bit too choppy and our group was a mix of folks looking to relax and people dressed up for dinner.
author: Marco_R

title: Great time at sea
text: We had excellent several hours on a nice sailing boat with capitan Jose at the steering. Everything happened to be great - the weather, the boat, and our captain was the best. Very helpful, polite and entertaining. The food and drinks were good too. The whole company enjoyed this trip, including refreshening swimming. Thank you very much for this experience. Very much recommended. Mila and family.
author: Travel18393655539

title: Calm and enjoyable ride!
text: Wonderful experience! Nice and calm boat ride.  Tapas and beverages were delicious. The boat captain was so calm and let us enjoy our time.
author: Hcshank

title: Great time
text: It was so much fun! Marcelo was amazing.  He taught us, made us laugh.  He really made our day. And the cava was flowing.
author: Michelle_S

title: Loved it great people it’s was a pleasure meeting you guys
text: Had an amazing time with Mauricio he was a great captain and very nice friendly. Made the experience very special for me since it was my first time on a sailboat the Spanish tapas were delicious the Cava was so good. Would love to come back again and charlotte was amazing as well thank you guys for a very special vacation keep up the good work your friends from New York
author: shirley m

title: Exceptional  Sailing in the Mediterranean Sea!
text: An exceptional trip. Our captain Luigi was fun and the group was the perfect size and the view was beautiful. The weather was amazing. It was a wonderful trip.
author: marienz2023

title: Love Sailing in Barcelona
text: The Pilot Jose was an excellent host and he ensured that we enjoy every moment  Although it was supposed to be a group trip but we were lucky and only self and wife were the passengers. I am thankful to the company for not cancelling the tour as it happens in most part of world due to low occupancy. Jose ensured flow of beer / wine / cava and made our 33rd Anniversary the best one
author: Vibhas_C
